annotations.title: Edit or remove a Pinterest audience

description: Rename a Pinterest audience, change its description or rule, or REMOVE it (remove:true). Removing is destructive — any ad group that includes or excludes it loses that targeting and Pinterest has no undo — so it needs confirm:true; without it nothing changes and the reply names what would go. Read back from Pinterest afterwards. 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

audienceId.description: id of the audience to rename, edit or remove

remove.description: true removes the audience; requires confirm:true

rule.description: raw Pinterest rule fields merged onto the audience's existing rule (expert use)

name: update_pinterest_ads_audience
